source: docs/gdd.md section 5, Qualities: one model for everything
note: Every fact the story can check is a quality: a named integer on the player's record. An agent may only read or set a name listed here. A draft that needs a new quality reports it; it is added here by Jeremy before that draft ships.

skill.set_by: the idle loop, never by a storylet

needle.set_by: failed or risky storylets; falls 1 per 24h

record.set_by: the engine, never by a storylet: record.check_ins counts visits, a check-in at least an hour after the last counted one (Jeremy, 22 October 2026, after the 48-hour assay)

open_questions: The flag list is empty. The GDD names example flags (gave Page 1 to Inkwell, partnered with the Baron) but no complete set. Flags get added here as each act's beats are written.
The GDD does not name the item qualities for the 24 Ledger Pages individually. Decide whether they are 24 item ids or one counter plus a set of flags.
Nerve's cap of 10 is stated, and the Night Lamp raises it to 14. Whether the cap is a quality or a config value is an engine decision, not a canon one.
